text:
maria_csm: Starting Northwind Health onboarding thread. They want Redwood Private in their AWS account for PHI. Goal: 7 weeks to production. I propose owners below; add if missing.

maria_csm: Owners: Maria (CSM), Alex (SE), Joanne (Platform Eng), Ken (Ops), Sam (Enablement), Ruth (Program). External: Pri (Northwind PM), Omar (Sec).

maria_csm: Success criteria draft:
- Private endpoints + peering verified and documented
- SAML + SCIM end-to-end smoke test passing
- PHI field mapping signed by customer (POE)
- Pilot flows p50 <300ms for 95%
- Training + runbook handed off to customer ops

alex_se: Ill own integration checklist and test harness. Need sample payloads + SAML metadata from Pri. Ill ship checklist by Thu.

joanne_eng: Ill validate VPC routing, SGs, and draft autoscale suggestions. Q: expected pilot RPS?

maria_csm: Preliminary from Pri: pilot ~40 RPS, steady ~180 RPS. Ill confirm numbers.

ken_ops: Ill manage certs/KMS. Note if they supply keys certs take 3-5 biz days; HSM/KMS link adds ~1 week. Also need SOC2/BAA asks early.

sam_cs: Enablement will run two sessions (dev + ops) and create quickstart + recording. Ill also own initial dashboard metrics (uptime, p50, p95, errors).

ruth_pm: Ill own timeline & canary plan. Proposal: W0 kickoff, W1 infra, W2 integration, W3 internal tests, W4 pilot (10% traffic for 48-72h), W5 iterate, W6 go-live + 30d check.

maria_csm: Risks: SAML metadata delay, ambiguous PHI schema, keys/certs lag, contract addenda.

maria_csm: Action items:
- Maria: confirm RPS + request SAML + sample payloads (by Tue)
- Alex: integration checklist (Thu)
- Joanne: network checklist + autoscale draft (mid next week)
- Ken: cert/KMS runbook + compliance doc list (Wed)
- Sam: enablement schedule + slides (next Fri)
- Ruth: canary + rollback playbook (Wed)

maria_csm: @onboardbot please schedule 60m kickoff with Northwind + internal owners next Tue 10am PT and paste invite here.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Tue 10:00 AM PT  60m  "Northwind Health: Redwood Private Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/northwind (invites sent).

alex_se: :thumbsup: blocking time.

joanne_eng: Ill draft autoscale policy and add KV cache warmup note.

ken_ops: Will prepare cert checklist and ask legal about addenda.

sam_cs: Ill start slide draft and propose two training slots.

ruth_pm: Ill create project board and add tasks.

maria_csm: Thanks all. Ill post updates here as Pri sends artifacts. Flag any timeline risks in thread or DM me. :rocket:
